description: RevenueDot's MIT fork of RevenueCat's web SDK (purchases-js), pointed at RevenueDot, the open-source RevenueCat alternative for in-app purchases and subscriptions.
rules: Install with `npm install @revenuedot/purchases-js`, or alias it as "@revenuecat/purchases-js": "npm:@revenuedot/purchases-js@<version>" to keep existing imports.
Use `import { Purchases } from "@revenuedot/purchases-js"` and `Purchases.configure({ apiKey, appUserId })` with the web app's public key from the RevenueDot dashboard.
RevenueDot Cloud (https://api.revenuedot.app) is the default API host. For a self-hosted server, pass `httpConfig: { proxyURL: "https://revenuedot.example.com" }` with no trailing slash.
Analytics events follow `proxyURL` too, so `collectAnalyticsEvents` can stay on.
